hook.name: EggsFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Eggs Launchpad pools that charges a flat fee (0.1%–5.2%) on ETH-denominated swaps: taken from the input on buys (beforeSwap) and from the output on sells (afterSwap), forwarded to a per-pool fee vault. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; exact-output swaps revert. Pool registration is restricted to a single authorized factory address.
